paired.scope: Pre-action q/qdot/actuator targets, base-relative physical poses, object/goal velocities and legal masks; tolerance 1e-5 in each reported unit. Hidden PhysX/sensor state and future random draws not claimed exact.

capture_writer.byte_scope: owned payload arrays, including retained buffers; excludes bounded flush/compressor scratch
capture_writer.verification_scope: Bound includes queued and running closed-file tasks; only paths/metadata sent. Spawned verifier decode buffers/RSS are separate from payload byte budget.

A.scope: Batch aggregate; padding duplicates current views only, is discarded, and is not an observation or training exposure

B.scope: Batch aggregate; padding duplicates current views only, is discarded, and is not an observation or training exposure

wave_profiles.admission_scope: Sum of sequential admit_capture calls after wave execution; includes provenance, source-label/camera checks and admission receipt writes; excluded from wave seconds

interpretation: Collection rescue success is not autonomous success; stage-reaching is censored by actual takeover, never inferred beyond student prefix.
